_comment: Connection-standard port contract for the proposal-review organ. inputs = the top-level keys decide() reads from `state` (verified by AST scan: exactly the state.get("X") literals in organ.py). outputs = the top-level keys decide() writes under the result `output` dict (verified behaviourally as the union across the committed samples, which cover all 5 dispatched kinds). `context` overrides (persona_roles tuning) and nested keys (session_result.summary/findings, change_list item fields) are NOT ports. `kind` is the required discriminator; all other inputs are kind-specific and optional. Several names appear on both sides (persona_name, role, person_name, error) because the organ reads them from state and re-emits them normalized under output. Types map to the vendored types.json; reconcile names with the canonical orchestrator types.json once readable.
